purpose: Replace overfitted six-bit six-law development fixture with structurally distinct contextual causal worlds, certify information-identifiability, strong fully trained same-information controls, consequential intervention benefit and cold retention BEFORE any new native-learning method.

world_design.actions: 16 do(x_i:=0|1), at most two real sequential actions, cost .08 per action
world_design.world_seed_derivation: SHA-256('AAI12P-world-v1|'+exact private world ID+'|'+field), select rule indices deterministically from disjoint permitted candidates, no search or rejected seed loops. Algorithm follows frozen family DAG templates. World ID is never in public observations.
world_design.law_structure: 4-stage causal DAG m0, m1 from distinct x pairs; m2 may depend on upstream mediator and context bit; m3 depends on earlier mediator(s), x and family-specific compensation or inhibition. Three operators xor/and/or plus negated/compositional terms; each template pre-registered and deterministic.
world_design.identity: Family and specific rule parameters hidden from learner; each episode exposes ONLY public x, mediator bits, goal, reward, actions_taken. Exogenous do-action sets exactly one x bit and recomputes downstream DAG.

study.common_training: Per fixture 4 original fit worlds in listed order, 8 actual exogenous do-action pairs each, total 64 identical public observations per model. Fit must be completed using only these 64 rows before cold checkpoint.
study.challenge: Each unfamiliar world receives 4 actual exogenous do-action pairs (8 public rows), all matched learners see identical public observations and then a frozen independently restored post-challenge checkpoint per episode.
study.evaluation: 8 deterministic original public (x,goal) context pairs per unfamiliar world per fixture, source SHA derived, independent of learner name; total 2 fixtures x12 transfer worlds x8 contexts=192 consequential episodes per method with 0..2 self-selected true interventions and only own observable consequences. Same-goal achievable fraction measured relative to exact oracle; all rewards counted.
study.familiar_retention: Repeat independently cold A/B evaluation on four fit worlds using 4 exogenous challenge pairs and same context algorithm, 2 fixtures x4 worlds x8=64 additional episodes per method; no training source contamination.

controls.original_model_reuse: AAI-11P controls are six-bit/three-mediators and therefore inapplicable as exact matched baselines; implement fresh honest eight-bit/four-mediator fully trained controls on same public data and 0..2 actual action limits; no private world ID/spec hidden-law oracle.
controls.fit: All eight eligible method implementations fit on identical 64 public training events, then update with identical four challenge intervention pairs; linear logistic pair model fitted with 250 complete deterministic gradient passes on all available public observations and again after challenge. Causal structure baselines fit exhaustive public pairwise Boolean grammar over x and previous visible m, strongest among full/recent windows selected on actual outcomes, include family-specific m2/m3 interaction grammar (not cripple controls).
controls.decision: Shared same two-action planning method with cost .08; independently choose actual interventions and update on own true observed outcome. Compare strongest by actual mean reward, report oracle baseline and incidental reactive/random/STOP diagnostic separately.
controls.source_only_compute: CPU with bounded public model/action cache, no paid model, no GPU requirement.

pre_registered_admission.negative_control: Shuffle public post-intervention mediator outcomes across distinct true (x,do) transitions at fixed marginals; compare structural learner on corrupted vs intact, do not call a GO if corrupted learning is better under prespecified guard.
pre_registered_admission.statistics: Mechanics source-only descriptive; hold out genuine random independent world clusters until separately authorized scientific first-use. Do not treat sampled fixed worlds as 12 independent science transfer clusters.

safety.qualification: source-only Linux/Windows original benchmark test + mandatory full exact-head native tests, G29 generated atlas only
